research_scope: Official documentation and upstream sources. Supported earns shared gold. Unknown/partial/planned earns no medal and is not evidence of absence. Claims describe documented capabilities, not runtime acceptance or platform performance.

players.name: Foxide
players.note: Current Foxide launches external mpv; it is not an independent playback engine.

players.name: Windows Media Player
players.note: Packaged-app activation requires a dedicated adapter; Get-AppxPackage and Start Apps inventory are checked.

players.name: FFplay
players.note: Reference player, outside the selected ten. Its default decoder/render configuration can differ from GPU-decoding desktop players.

players.name: Plex
players.note: Desktop player only; local-file/server/account setup requires an adapter. Plex Media Server is not substituted.

players.name: foobar2000
players.note: Audio-only entrant. Video categories are not applicable.

players.name: Infuse
players.note: App Store distribution; provision on an authorized self-hosted Mac. No Windows WinGet package is substituted.

players.name: IINA
players.note: Installed by Homebrew cask in the hosted macOS workflow. GUI launch alone is not playback verification.

players.name: QuickTime Player
players.note: OS-provided native reference; requires a validated file-activation and playback collector.
